translations.b0160: Part 6  Accelerating the Building of a High-Standard Socialist Market Economy and Strengthening the Driving Forces for High-Quality Development
translations.b0161: China will uphold and improve the basic socialist economic system, better leverage the leading role of economic structural reform, build a high-standard market system, improve the effectiveness of macroeconomic governance, promote the optimal allocation and maximum returns of resources, stimulate the internal driving forces and innovative vitality of society as a whole, and ensure steady and sustained progress in high-quality development.
translations.b0162: Chapter 18  Fully Stimulating the Vitality of All Types of Business Entities
translations.b0163: China will uphold and implement the “two unswervings,” promote complementarity of strengths among economic sectors under all forms of ownership, and advance their common development.
translations.b0164: Section 1  Deepening the Reform of State-Owned Capital and State-Owned Enterprises
translations.b0165: State-owned enterprises and state-owned capital will be made stronger, better and larger; the core functions of state-owned enterprises will be enhanced; and their core competitiveness will be raised. A catalogue guiding the optimization of the layout and structural adjustment of the state-owned economy will be formulated and implemented, and state-owned capital will be channeled toward important industries and key areas that bear on national security and the lifelines of the national economy, toward public services, emergency response capacity and public-interest fields that bear on the national economy and people’s wellbeing, and toward forward-looking strategic emerging industries, with strategic restructuring and specialized consolidation stepped up. Classified reform of state-owned enterprises will be deepened; the functional positioning of different types of state-owned enterprises will be further clarified; management of their main responsibilities and core business will be strengthened; an evaluation system for the fulfillment of strategic missions by state-owned enterprises will be established; and a governance system of classified assessment will be developed. State-owned enterprises will be encouraged to improve market-based operating mechanisms and enhance their value creation capacity. Institutional arrangements for state-owned enterprises to advance original innovation will be improved. The state-owned assets supervision system will be improved, and state-owned capital investment and operation companies will be better positioned to play their role. The value-added accounting system for the state-owned economy and state-owned enterprises will be improved. State-owned enterprises and private enterprises will be supported in conducting equity cooperation, strategic collaboration and resource integration in a standardized, market-based manner.
translations.b0166: Section 2  Developing and Expanding the Private Economy
translations.b0167: The Law on Promoting the Private Economy will be implemented and supporting laws, regulations, policies and systems will be improved, so as to guarantee by law and by institutional arrangements equal access to production factors, fair participation in market competition and effective protection of lawful rights and interests. Competitive areas of infrastructure will continue to be opened fairly to private enterprises. Capable private enterprises will be supported in taking the lead in undertaking major national technological breakthrough tasks, and major national scientific research infrastructure and public R&D platforms will be opened further to private enterprises. Policies supporting financing for private enterprises will be improved; the role of the national integrated financing credit service platform network will be brought into play; and the comprehensive credit evaluation system and the credit enhancement system will be improved. Small and medium-sized enterprises and self-employed individuals will be supported in their development, and the coordinated and integrated development of large, medium and small enterprises will be promoted. The “Jinjiang experience” will be developed through innovation; a comprehensive service system for the development of the private economy will be improved; and mechanisms for regular government-enterprise communication and problem solving will be refined. Private enterprises will be guided to improve their governance structures and management systems, and the healthy development of the private economy and the healthy growth of people working in the private economy will be promoted. The statistical monitoring system for the private economy will be improved.
translations.b0168: Section 3  Actively Fostering a First-Class Business Environment
translations.b0169: Continuous efforts will be made to improve and upgrade the business environment and create a first-class business environment that is market-oriented, law-based and internationalized. The service system for enterprises will be improved; the list management and routine advancement mechanism for key matters under the “handle one matter efficiently in one go” reform will be improved; enterprise-benefiting policies will be handled fully online and delivered directly and promptly; and the credit commitment system will be promoted. Reform of the registered capital subscription registration system will be deepened, and business-related operating permits will be continuously streamlined. A long-term mechanism for regulating law enforcement involving enterprises will be improved; unlawful cross-jurisdictional law enforcement and profit-driven law enforcement will be prevented and corrected; and joint law enforcement approaches such as “one comprehensive inspection” will be promoted. Law enforcement and judicial protection of property rights will be strengthened, and judicial supervision over coercive measures such as sealing, seizure and freezing will be enhanced. A long-term mechanism for clearing arrears owed to enterprises will be established and improved, and complaint channels for government breach of contract and broken promises will be kept open. The modern enterprise system with Chinese characteristics will be improved, the entrepreneurial spirit will be promoted, and the building of more world-class enterprises will be accelerated.
translations.b0170: Chapter 19  Accelerating the Improvement of the Systems and Mechanisms for the Market-Based Allocation of Production Factors
translations.b0171: China will deepen market-oriented reform of production factors, keep channels open for their orderly flow, coordinate the optimization of incremental factors with the revitalization of existing factors, and promote the efficient allocation of all types of factor resources.
translations.b0172: Section 1  Improving the Systems and Rules of the Factor Market
translations.b0173: The factor market system will be improved, and the scope of market-based factor allocation will be expanded. Reform of the land system will be deepened, and a unified urban and rural market for construction land will be established and improved. The functions of the capital market will be improved so that investment and financing are coordinated; basic systems such as issuance and listing, information disclosure, mergers and acquisitions, and delisting will be optimized; the quality of listed companies will be improved; and a long-term mechanism for enhancing intrinsic stability will be established. Channels for the social mobility of labor and talent will be kept open, and institutional obstacles relating to household registration, social security, professional titles and personnel files will be gradually removed. A nationally integrated technology market and data market will be cultivated. The comprehensive pilot reform for the market-based allocation of production factors will be deepened and expanded, and a number of replicable and transferable institutional outcomes will be produced at a faster pace.
translations.b0174: Section 2  Improving the Pricing Mechanisms for Resource Factors
translations.b0175: Pricing mechanisms that are mainly determined by market supply and demand will be improved, and price governance will be strengthened and improved. Pricing mechanisms suited to a new energy system will be improved at a faster pace; market-based reform of the on-grid prices of various types of power generation will be advanced by category and at an appropriate pace; the pricing mechanism for refined oil products will be improved; reform of natural gas pricing will be deepened; policies for regulating coal prices within a range will be improved; and price regulation of network-type natural monopoly segments will be strengthened. Reform of water pricing for water conservancy projects will be deepened. Public utility pricing mechanisms that promote sustainable development will be improved, and the systems of tiered residential water, electricity and gas pricing will be optimized. Reform of public service pricing will be deepened, and charging policies for services such as elderly care will be improved. The development of pricing mechanisms for new types of production factors will be explored.
translations.b0176: Section 3  Revitalizing and Utilizing Existing Resources
translations.b0177: Policies on mergers and acquisitions, bankruptcy and asset swaps will be improved, and inefficiently used land, idle properties and existing infrastructure will be revitalized and put to good use. Macro balance sheets will be compiled, a full picture of existing resource assets will be obtained, and asset-liability structures will be optimized. Pilot programs for redeveloping inefficiently used land will be deepened and expanded; planning controls, land supply and tax and fee policies that facilitate the revitalization of existing land will be improved; and the secondary market for construction land will be developed at a faster pace. Mixed land development, composite use of space and lawful and reasonable conversion of land use purposes will be promoted; laws and regulations on the renewal of land use rights for industrial and commercial land will be improved; and renewal work will be advanced steadily in accordance with the law. The revitalization and sharing of existing state-owned assets held by administrative departments and public institutions across the country will be promoted; mechanisms for revitalizing existing assets in industrial parks and promoting their high-quality development will be improved; supporting policies such as asset valuation will be refined; non-governmental actors will be brought in to improve the efficiency of revitalization and utilization; and market-based operating procedures will be standardized. The execution of judicial judgments will be linked organically with the bankruptcy system, and sealed or frozen property will be effectively revitalized in accordance with the law. The regular recommendation and issuance of real estate investment trusts (REITs) in the infrastructure sector will be actively promoted.
translations.b0178: Chapter 20  Improving the Macroeconomic Governance System
translations.b0179: China will improve the level of macroeconomic regulation and government governance, and promote a shift toward development models in which domestic demand plays the leading role, consumption drives growth and growth is internally generated.
translations.b0180: Section 1  Improving the Macroeconomic Regulation System
translations.b0181: The strategic guiding role of national development planning will be strengthened; fiscal and monetary policies will be better coordinated; the roles of industrial, pricing, employment, consumption, investment, trade, regional, environmental protection and regulatory policies will be brought into play; and the consistency and effectiveness of the orientation of macro policies will be enhanced. Counter-cyclical and cross-cyclical adjustments will be strengthened, a more proactive macro policy will be implemented, the scale of government debt will be determined appropriately, ample liquidity will be maintained, and growth, employment and expectations will be continuously stabilized. The system of macroeconomic regulation targets will be improved; short-term and medium- to long-term targets, and aggregate balance and structural adjustment, will be coordinated; and the linkage between annual plans and national development planning will be strengthened. The expectations management mechanism will be improved, and expectations management will be incorporated into the entire process of macroeconomic governance. Economic monitoring, forecasting and early warning will be strengthened; the policy toolkit will be enriched and improved; the intensity and timing of policies will be handled in a well-calibrated manner; and evaluation of the effects of policy implementation will be strengthened. The management of national macro balance sheets will be explored. The comprehensive performance assessment for high-quality development will be optimized.
translations.b0182: Section 2  Improving the Modern Fiscal System
translations.b0183: Reform of the fiscal and tax systems will be deepened; the role of proactive fiscal policy will be brought into play; scientific fiscal management will be strengthened; and fiscal sustainability will be enhanced. Macro-level guidance over budget preparation and fiscal policy will be strengthened; the role of medium-term fiscal plans in balancing budgets across years will be brought into play; and fiscal resources will be firmly secured for major national strategic tasks and for meeting basic living needs. Fiscal resources and budgets will be better coordinated; greater efforts will be made to coordinate government fund budgets, state capital operations budgets and general public budgets; the state capital operations budget system will be improved; the proportion of state-owned capital returns collected will be raised appropriately; and all revenue obtained by virtue of administrative power, government credit and state-owned resources and assets will be incorporated into government budget management. The structure of fiscal expenditure will be optimized, and the share of spending on public services within total fiscal expenditure will be raised appropriately. The reform of zero-based budgeting will be deepened; budget allocation authority will be unified; the expenditure standards system and its dynamic adjustment mechanism will be improved; and budget performance management and oversight of budget execution will be strengthened. The tax system structure will be optimized; a tax system conducive to high-quality development, social fairness and market unification will be improved; and the overall tax burden will be kept at a reasonable level. The proportion of direct taxes will be raised; the personal income tax system that combines comprehensive and classified taxation will be improved; the scope of comprehensive taxation will be gradually expanded; and tax policies for business income, capital income and property income will be improved. The VAT credit refund policy and the deduction chain will be improved, and the sharing ratio of shared taxes will be optimized. Tax systems suited to new forms of business will be studied. The local tax system will be improved; the point of collection of consumption tax will be moved downstream and the tax will be steadily devolved to local governments; and local governments’ own fiscal resources will be increased. Central government authority will be appropriately strengthened, the share of central fiscal expenditure will be raised, and central fiscal responsibilities delegated to local governments will be reduced. The fiscal transfer payment system will be improved, and the structure of fiscal transfer payments will be optimized. The principle of statutory taxation will be fully implemented; preferential tax policies will be regulated; and financial and accounting oversight will be strengthened. A long-term mechanism for government debt management suited to high-quality development will be established at a faster pace.
translations.b0184: Section 3  Accelerating the Building of a Financial Powerhouse
translations.b0185: With a commitment to preventing risks, strengthening regulation and promoting high-quality development, the building of a modern financial system with Chinese characteristics will be accelerated. The central banking system will be improved; a scientific and prudent monetary policy system will be developed; the mechanism for injecting base money will be improved; the market-based mechanisms for interest rate formation, regulation and transmission will be improved; and the growth of aggregate financing to the real economy and the money supply will be kept in line with economic growth and the expected target for the overall price level. A comprehensive macro-prudential management system will be established, and more financial activities and financial markets will be incorporated into the macro-prudential policy framework. The flexibility of the RMB exchange rate will be enhanced, and the exchange rate will be kept basically stable at a reasonable and balanced level. The quality and effectiveness of financial services for the real economy will be improved; vigorous efforts will be made to develop sci-tech finance, green finance, inclusive finance, pension finance and digital finance; and high-quality financial services will be strengthened for major strategies, key areas and weak links. The system of structural monetary policy instruments will be improved. Comprehensive reform of investment and financing in the capital market will be deepened continuously; the institutional inclusiveness and adaptability of the capital market will be enhanced; and the proportion of direct financing will be increased. Diversified equity financing will be developed; the building of a multi-tiered bond market will be accelerated; futures, derivatives and asset securitization will be developed steadily; and trading regulation and investor protection will be strengthened. Patient capital will be expanded, and the policy system supporting the entry of medium- and long-term funds into the market will be improved. The financial institution system will be optimized; financial institutions of all types will be encouraged to focus on their core business, improve governance and pursue differentiated development; large state-owned financial institutions will be supported in improving their comprehensive service levels; access standards and regulatory requirements for small and medium-sized financial institutions will be tightened; and first-class investment banks and investment institutions will be cultivated. Safe and efficient financial infrastructure will be built. The digital renminbi will be developed steadily. The building of the Shanghai International Financial Center will be accelerated. Financial regulation will be strengthened across the board, a risk prevention and resolution system will be developed, and the sound operation of the financial sector will be safeguarded.
